name: FieldScoutingObservationApp
tagline: Pest, disease and weed scouting – from field walk to treated and re-scouted.
description: A complete agronomy scouting app in one Power Apps code component: log observations with growth stage, severity, pressure and photos, compare them with economic thresholds, recommend and schedule actions, record treatments, re-scout for efficacy and see risk per field on a map – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 11 KPI tiles incl. above threshold, overdue actions, re-scouts due and fields at risk
Configurable economic thresholds per issue with near-threshold band
Pressure vs threshold meter with % of threshold
Severity, growth stage and photo capture (resized on the device)
Recommend → schedule → treat → re-scout → close workflow with rules
Justification required for actions below threshold
Field risk scoring, risk map and field × category heat table
Scouting and follow-up calendar with phone agenda
Bulk schedule & assign, re-scout date, close and CSV export
Undo, validation, read-only, disabled, empty and map-your-columns states
Phone bottom bar, tablet and desktop layouts
controlType: standard (2 controls: FieldScoutingObservationApp data-set + FieldScoutingObservationAppPortal field)
